outline.name: HIMSS CPHIMS Outline of Exam Topics
outline.version: CPHIMS Candidate Handbook, effective May 1, 2024 (four content areas: Environments 25%, Clinical Informatics 20%, Systems Management 30%, Management and Leadership 25%)
outline.source: https://dakotas.himss.org/sites/hde/files/media/file/2025/01/14/cphims-handbook.pdf (HIMSS-hosted copy of the handbook, cover reads Effective May 1, 2024; outline on pages 6 to 9)
outline.notes: 71 tasks, all paraphrased from the handbook text, none copied. The handbook numbers tasks within each area (Environments A.1 to A.5 and B.1 to B.2; Clinical Informatics A.1 to A.6; Systems Management A.1 to A.10, B.1 to B.6, C.1 to C.6, D.1 to D.4, E.1 to E.7; Management and Leadership A.1 to A.25). IDs reuse the course's existing meta.js codes, which map one to one: E1 to E5 = Environments A.1 to A.5, E6 and E7 = Environments B.1 and B.2, C1 to C6 = Clinical Informatics A.1 to A.6, SA/SB/SC/SD/SE = Systems Management A to E, L1 to L25 = Management and Leadership A.1 to A.25. Every task has its own code, so no closest-code substitutions. In the PDF layout A.9 (legal and regulatory compliance) and A.10 (ethical business principles) print on one line in swapped order; L9 and L10 follow the A.9 and A.10 numbering, which matches meta.js. Item C.1 and C.2 text in the PDF is visibly garbled (a fragment of C.1 landed on C.2); paraphrases follow the evident meaning. Cognitive levels in the handbook are Recall, Application, Analysis; the kind field here is our own call, not HIMSS's.
